en.title: Lost passport abroad: the 7 steps
en.note: Before any of this: photograph your passport today
en.focal: A backup copy makes step 4 much faster
en.alt: Hand-drawn path of the seven steps after losing a passport abroad: confirm it's really gone, file a police report, contact your embassy, emergency travel document, notify your insurer, check your visa situation, get home then replace it - with a note to photograph your passport today because a backup copy makes step four much faster
en.caption: Seven calm steps, in order - and the one thing to do today, before any of them are ever needed.
